claims.evidence: Witness report shows only the sofa appearance (color, 2-seater, tufted/stitching). No usage-time evidence is visible.
Witness report does not include measurements or a scale reference; only that it is a 2-seater sofa.

risks.risk: Material/quality uncertainty (fabric vs leather vs faux leather) affecting durability and cleaning cost
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the upholstery texture with a clear view of seams/edges showing whether it is fabric or leather-like, plus any label/tag if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic upholstered 2-seater with unknown material quality (worst-case for resale).

risks.risk: Hidden damage or heavy wear (stains, tears, rips, burns, peeling, worn foam) not visible in the current shots
risks.proof: Wide + close-up photos of the entire seat/back/arms and underside, including corners and stitching, in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed clean/undamaged (worst-case for condition).

risks.risk: Frame/suspension issues (sagging, wobble, broken springs) and cushion firmness
risks.proof: A short video clip showing someone pressing/sitting on the sofa from front and side to demonstrate firmness and any wobble/sag.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing repair/with uncertain structural integrity.

risks.risk: Missing features or mismatched function (recline/bed function/removable covers) not shown
risks.proof: Photos of the back, sides, and any mechanisms/hinges; if covers exist, show zippers/attachments and how they come off.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard non-convertible 2-seater with no removable/extra parts guaranteed.

risks.risk: Size/fit uncertainty (exact length/width/height) impacting buyer usability and transport cost
risks.proof: A measurement photo with a tape measure across the longest side and height, or a clear reference object of known size.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a typical 2-seater with unknown exact length (worst-case for transport/fit).

risks.risk: Brand/model not identifiable; watermark may not correspond to the actual manufacturer
risks.proof: Photo of any brand tag/label under the seat, on the back frame, or on the underside; also a clear shot without watermark overlay.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unbranded/unknown model (worst-case for resale value).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of upholstery material (fabric vs leather/faux) and seams/edges.
Send full-condition photos: front, back, both arms, corners, underside—showing any stains/tears/peeling.
Send a short video of a person sitting/pressing to confirm cushion firmness and check for wobble/sagging.
Send photos of any tags/labels (under seat/back/underside) to confirm brand/model.
Send a measurement photo with tape measure for length and height (and width if possible).
Confirm whether any pillows/covers are included and show them if present.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a 2-seater sofa and describe visible styling, so it can be priced at its worst-case condition. Seller claims about usage time and length are not verifiable from the provided report, so pricing should assume uncertainty.
